mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary easing reduces cost of capital.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns through increased construction spending and consumer confidence over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, unemployment rates below 3.5% signal labor market overheating, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% in late-cycle expansions but 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 > 20000 signal robust industrial output and GDP growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns through sustained corporate earnings over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 > 20000 but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 255.2 index points signals accelerating inflation, prompting immediate monetary tightening that reduces equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 255.2 but 5-day returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month changes in retail sales (RSAFS) correlate with rising consumer spending, driving consistent S&P 500 gains over 60 trading days through sustained consumption.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases but 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.8% signal strong employment growth and labor market tightness, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through wage growth and consumer spending.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.8% but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes, INDPRO exceeding 100 index points indicates manufacturing sector rebound, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through industrial production growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 in post-shock recovery but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases.
